notes.title: 🎉 Grace Online Demo Now Available! Experience the Adventure up to Level 10! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello, dear adventurers!

We're thrilled to announce the release of the Grace Online Demo! Dive into our expansive 3D fantasy world and embark on a journey. This demo gives you a taste of the immersive MMORPG experience that Grace Online offers, allowing you to explore, craft, and level up to 10.

Why Play the Demo?

Experience the World: Get a firsthand look at the captivating environments, intriguing quests, and dynamic item placements that make Grace Online stand out.
Crafting & Exploration: Delve into our unique crafting system and discover its myriad possibilities. Explore the world, gather resources, and see what unique items you can create!
Begin Your Journey: While the demo caps at level 10, the adventures you'll embark on and the stories you'll uncover will leave you craving for more.
SEO Keywords: 3D Fantasy MMORPG, Grace Online, Crafting System, Exploration, Solo-Developed Game, Dynamic Item Placement, Free Demo, Steam Game Release.

We've poured our heart and soul into creating Grace Online, and this demo is just a glimpse of the larger, more expansive world we've built for you. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so after playing the demo, please share your thoughts, suggestions, and experiences. We're always listening and looking to improve.

Thank you for your continued support. Dive in, explore, and let the adventure begin!

notes.title: Unleash Your Destiny in the Epic Quest Challenge!
notes.notes:
Dear Grace Adventurers,

We're excited to introduce the Epic Quest Challenge! This 30-day contest is your opportunity to demonstrate your skills and claim your destiny.

Here's your mission:

Gather 100 Mellows, our premium coin currency, through Challenge Quests.
Complete all quests given by our NPC, Kaida. The first quest is available from level 5.
Obtain all Runes of Destiny - S, E, N, C, O, R, I, A.
Reach the prestigious level 60.
The first 10 heroes to complete all tasks will share the grand prize pool of $10,000! The next 15 winners will receive valuable in-game items as rewards.

Are you ready to take on this challenge and carve your destiny in the Realm of Grace? We can't wait to see your triumphant achievements!

All rewards will be distributed within 45 days after the competition ends. For a detailed understanding of the contest rules, please visit our Contest Rules page.


To learn more about the Epic Quest Challenge, visit our [url=https://playgraceonline.com/contest-Epic-Quest-Challenge]Contest Page[/url].

notes.title: Grace Online: Major Update V0.8.0.41 - New Adventures & Surprises Await!
notes.notes:
[h1]📰 Grace Online - Major Update V0.8.0.41 Brings a Wealth of New Features! 📰[/h1]
Hello, Grace Online adventurers!

We're beyond excited to share the latest news from the realm of Grace Online. The highly anticipated Update V0.8.0.41 has arrived on Steam! This substantial update is one of our most expansive yet, overflowing with fresh content, enhancements, and bug fixes set to drastically elevate your in-game journey.

[h2]📌 The Adventure Unfolds in V0.8.0.41[/h2]
[h3]Embark on Fresh Quests![/h3]
Adventure calls, brave souls! Prepare to step into uncharted lands, cross paths with intriguing characters, and rise to the challenges in our exciting new quests.

[h3]Unearth Powerful New Weapons & Armors![/h3]
Our armory has expanded! With a collection of brand-new weapons and armors, each offering unique capabilities and stats, your perfect battle gear is waiting to be discovered. Are you ready to equip yourself for glory?

[h3]Specialized Weapons and Skills for Each Class![/h3]
Your chosen class is now more distinctive and rewarding than ever. With unique weapons and skills for each class, the time to master your abilities is now. 

[h3]Immerse Yourself in Revamped Animations![/h3]
Experience Grace Online like never before! With 90% of our animations updated, we promise a visually stunning and immersive journey that you'll fall in love with.

[h3]Strategize with the Overhauled Skill System![/h3]
We've enhanced the skill system to provide a more balanced and engaging gameplay experience. Prepare to strategize and make every skill count!

[h3]Optimize with the Updated Character Stats System![/h3]
A fresh layer of strategy awaits! Mages now require Intelligence for their weapons and armor, and we've introduced a dedicated Mana stat. How will you optimize your character?

[h3]Explore UI Improvements & New Crafting Recipes![/h3]
To make your journey smoother, we've finessed the UI and added innovative crafting recipes. It's time to explore and create like never before!

[h2]🔧 Bug Fixes & Enhancements[/h2]
Good news! We've addressed the range skills missing issue, and the player collider problem is history. Brace yourself for smarter and more challenging monster encounters.

[h2]🎁 Surprises Await![/h2]
But that's not all, adventurers! We've sprinkled a few surprises in this update. Are you ready to discover them all?

[h2]📢 We Value Your Feedback![/h2]
Your voice shapes the world of Grace Online. We invite you to share your thoughts, suggestions, and experiences after delving into the new update.

We're thrilled for you to immerse yourself in all the fresh features and enhancements that Update V0.8.0.41 brings. See you in the realm!

Best, Deepankar Grace Online Team

notes.title: Grace Online - Now Available on Steam Early Access!
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers!

We are excited to announce that Grace Online, our solo-developed project, is now available on Steam Early Access! The game has been in development for some time, and we are thrilled to finally share it with the world.

In Grace Online, you will enter a beautiful open world full of wonders and dangers. Explore vast landscapes, encounter fierce creatures, and uncover hidden treasures. The game is still in development, and we need your help to make it even better.

By joining the early access community, you will have a chance to provide feedback and suggestions directly to the developer, shaping the game's development as it progresses. Your input will be essential in making Grace Online the best it can be.

We look forward to hearing your thoughts and ideas as we continue to work on the game. Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy playing Grace Online!

Best regards,
Overlight Studio

notes.title: Important Announcement: Delay of Grace Online
notes.notes:
We have some disappointing news to share with you today. Due to the discovery of several bugs during the final stages of development of the alpha 1 version of the game which was meant to be the early access version for Steam, we have decided to delay the early access launch of Grace Online on Steam.

We understand that this delay may be frustrating for many of you, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience it may cause. However, we believe that it is important to ensure that the game is of the highest quality when it is finally released. Fixing these bugs is our top priority, and we are committed to doing whatever it takes to make sure that Grace Online is the best it can be.

We are currently working on finding a new launch date, and we will update you as soon as we have more information. In the meantime, we encourage you to visit our website ( https://playgraceonline.com/ ) to learn more about the game. Testing will be starting very soon, and we encourage all of our fans to participate and provide feedback.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. We value your support and are grateful for your continued interest in Grace Online. We can't wait for you to finally be able to play the game, and we appreciate your support as we work to fix the remaining issues.

Sincerely,
Team Grace Online
